1482_f7dcb7ee.original: SELECT      ym.segment,     SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(ym.date, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013,     SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(ym.date, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,     (SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(ym.date, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(ym.date, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END)) AS increase,     ((SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(ym.date, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(ym.date, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END))   SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(ym.date, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS percentage_increase FROM      yearmonth ym JOIN      customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid WHERE      c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND     c.currency = 'EUR' GROUP BY      ym.segment ORDER BY      percentage_increase DESC
1482_f7dcb7ee.corrected:
SELECT
    c.segment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(ym.date, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013,
    SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(ym.date, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(ym.date, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(ym.date, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END)) AS increase,
    ((SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(ym.date, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(ym.date, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(ym.date, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS percentage_increase
FROM
    yearmonth ym
JOIN
    customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid
WHERE
    c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND c.currency = 'EUR'
GROUP BY
    c.segment
ORDER BY
    percentage_increase DESC

        (

743_127025f0.corrected:
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT superhero.id) AS total_heroes,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN superhero.id END) AS marvel_heroes,
    ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN superhero.id END)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT superhero.id)::NUMERIC) * 100, 2) AS percentage_marvel
FROM
    superhero
JOIN
    alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id

WHERE
    alignment.alignment IN ('acts in their own self-interest', 'makes decisions based on their own moral code')
